lesson.text: Quick memory: how does a dog say 'leave me alone'? (A stiff body, a hard stare, lips back, a high tail.) Today: the hills, wild animals and guard dogs.
In the hills, stay with your group on the path, and make some noise as you walk: animals usually move away from people they can hear.
Never feed, follow or go closer to a wild animal. Seen one far away? Stop, stay together, and go back slowly the way you came.
Big shepherd dogs guard flocks of sheep. Go far round the flock, slowly. A guard dog runs at you: be a tree, then back away slowly.
After a sting, a swelling face or noisy breathing is an allergy emergency: call {number}. Someone with their own pen: a grown-up, or they, use it.
Try it in the world: open the practice hills. Then plan a real walk with your grown-ups.

choices: stay with your group on the path

exercises.prompt: A fox comes to your picnic. You...
choices: pack the food away and never feed it

exercises.prompt: Making some noise on the path helps animals hear you coming.
Far away you see a bear. You...
choices: stop and go back slowly with your group

exercises.prompt: Passing a flock with guard dogs, you...
A guard dog runs at you: put it in order.
items: back away slowly, far from the flock
exercises.explain: Be a tree, then back away slowly.

exercises.prompt: Guard dogs want to keep you away from their sheep.
Safe in the hills, or not?
exercises.explain: Noise and staying together are safe.

exercises.prompt: Someone is bitten by a snake. You...
choices: keep them still and calm and call {number}

exercises.prompt: A friend's face swells after a wasp sting. First...
Only the person's own auto-injector pen is used for them.
